entities.name: Ramirez DePietro
entities.description: Flamboyant pirate from Dominaria who pillaged the seas around Jamuraa and continued as a ghost.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Pirate queen with a vague past with Ramirez, commanding the Robaran Mercenaries.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: Tolarian shapeshifter who assumed Ramirez's form and claimed to have killed him.

entities.name: Infernal Medusa
entities.description: Released from Alchor's Tomb by Ramirez.

entities.name: Gwendlyn Di Corci
entities.description: Person Ramirez claims outmatched him in Urborg.

entities.name: Fountain of Youth
entities.description: Credited by Ramirez for his youthful looks.

events.summary: Ramirez and Tor Wauki fight Adira's Robaran Mercenaries, strand them, then plunder Koltos.
events.quote: After an initial victory stranding the Robarans on a sandbank, they sailed to Koltos

events.summary: The Robarans defeat Ramirez, sabotage his ship and leave him trapped on Koltos.
events.quote: they defeated Ramirez and sabotaged his ship

events.summary: Halfdane assumes Ramirez's form during the Madara-Edemi War and claims to have killed the original two years earlier.
events.quote: Halfdane claimed to have killed the original DePietro two years earlier

events.summary: Ramirez's spectral form haunts the seas off Jamuraa, signing on with new pirate crews.
events.quote: Ramirez's spectral form has been a feature of the seas off Jamuraa for centuries

relations.quote: Ramirez and the archer Tor Wauki the Elder fought against Adira's Robaran Mercenaries
Ramirez had a past with Adira Strongheart which was left purposely vague.
Halfdane claimed to have killed the original DePietro two years earlier
